# What is my R&D tax relief claim worth?

> Free UK R&D tax relief calculator: what the merged scheme credit or R&D-intensive loss-maker relief is worth in cash or tax, the PAYE and NIC cap, and what a claims agency's percentage fee would cost you. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
